Root cause was in `app/display.py:3-4` — it encoded names to UTF-8 bytes, then decoded with `"ascii", errors="ignore"`, which silently drops every non-ASCII byte. Any Arabic (or other non-Latin) name lost 100% of its bytes and came back empty.

Fix: `display_name` now truncates and title-cases the string directly instead of round-tripping through ASCII bytes:

```python
def display_name(name, limit=24):
    return name.strip()[:limit].title()
```
